name: GitLab merge request review
description: Review labelled GitLab merge requests at their current head and post a concise, non-approving review note with actionable findings.

gitlab.message: Requires a connected GitLab account or GITLAB_TOKEN with api scope to read merge requests and post notes. MCP-only access is not supported.

exampleImplementation: Poll open, non-draft labelled merge requests. Review the bounded diff at each exact head in a separate conversation, then publish one GitLab note per head. Do not approve or merge.

schedule.label: Check frequency
schedule.help: How often to check for labelled merge requests.

projects.label: Projects
projects.help: GitLab projects to review. Subgroups are supported.

triggerLabel.label: Trigger label
triggerLabel.help: Only open merge requests carrying this label are reviewed.

gitlabApiUrl.label: GitLab API URL
gitlabApiUrl.help: HTTPS /api/v4 root of the instance. Requires a connected GitLab account or GITLAB_TOKEN; MCP-only access is not supported.

setup.message: This deployment cannot run the bundled reviewer directly. Configure a scheduled poll of the selected GitLab projects and label, then create the automation.
